Description: Customers authenticate on mobile via the same OIDC/PKCE flow as the web app. Expo (managed) + expo-auth-session + expo-secure-store; calls api-identity. See ADR-003, ADR-001, DESIGN 2.

As a customer I want to sign in with my CIAM account so that I can reach my data. AC: Given unauthenticated, when I tap Sign in, then expo-auth-session runs PKCE and I land on Home with a valid access token. Negative: cancelled session returns to Sign In. DoD: token in memory only; tested offline.
As a customer I want my session to survive restart. AC: refresh token in expo-secure-store; access token in memory. DoD: no token in AsyncStorage.

As a customer I want to see my claims. AC: /api/me returns verified claims and the app renders them. Negative: expired token shows a clear session-expired state. DoD: proves api-identity aud check end-to-end.
As a customer I want to sign out. AC: local tokens cleared and IdP session ends. DoD: post-logout redirect returns to Sign In.
Enterprise/business partners require SAML 2.0 SSO. Spring Security saml2-service-provider on the Java auth surface (ADR-004) + Keycloak SAML client. SP-initiated then IdP-initiated.
As a partner user I want to SSO via my corporate IdP. AC: SP redirects to IdP, validates the XML signature on return, and issues a session. DoD: Spring Security validation (no hand-rolled XML).
As a partner user I want to start from my IdP portal. AC: unsolicited assertion validated for aud/destination/InResponseTo before session. DoD: stale-assertion replay rejected.
As a developer I want a SAML client in the local realm. AC: SP-initiated SSO completes against Keycloak. DoD: documented in keycloak/README.md.
Automated build -> test -> containerize. GitHub Actions; Java tests in Docker (JDK 21); build api-identity + ui-identity; push GHCR. See ADR-005.

AC: a tagged image deploys ui-identity (Vercel) and api-identity (Render) with OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_AUDIENCE from secrets.
Running demo against a real IdP. ui-identity -> Vercel; api-identity -> Render; mobile via Expo; IdP = Okta dev tenant. See ADR-005, DESIGN 5.

AC: Dockerfile runs on Render with OIDC_ISSUER/OIDC_AUDIENCE; /health is public.

AC: issuer + audience set to the Okta dev tenant; discovery + JWKS resolve; login still works.
